# Hot Tub Pads

Professional hot tub pad installation across Ontario. Concrete and gravel foundations for hot tubs, swim spas, and outdoor structures (gazebos, pergolas, outdoor kitchens, fire pits).

## Service Areas
London, Hamilton, Kitchener, Woodstock, Sarnia, St. Thomas — all in Ontario, Canada.

## Contact
- Email: sales@hottubpads.ca
- Address: 775 Osgoode Drive, Unit 12, London, ON, Canada
- Hours: Mon–Fri 8 AM – 6 PM, Sat 9 AM – 3 PM, Sun closed
